purpose: Uncertainty estimation only for the already-frozen T07 role-judge validation result.

frozen_estimand.population: same final adjudicated 300-item T06 human consensus and archived T07 automatic judge scores
frozen_estimand.scored_population: human_validity == 'ok' and lu_score is not None

metrics.macro_f1_ipweighted: four-class inverse-probability weighted macro-F1, canonical T07 convention
metrics.four_class_kappa: unweighted Cohen's kappa, canonical T07 convention

frozen_estimand.decision_rule: unchanged; PASS/FAIL remains based on frozen point estimates, not CI overlap

sampling.resampling: within each original stratum, with replacement

bootstrap.undefined_metric_handling: record per-metric invalid count; exclude only undefined/non-finite replicates from that metric's percentile calculation; never replace NaN with zero
